name: Fucosylated N- and O-glycan synthesis and selectin ligands
rationale: Members cover N-glycan and mucin O-glycan synthesis, GDP-fucose/fucosylation, sialylation and blood-group antigens plus tyrosine sulfation and leukocyte tethering/HSC homing, i.e. selectin-ligand glycans, which the nucleotide-sugar, sialic-acid and GAG confusables lack.

qualifier: MHC class II, lipid antigen and TLR7/8
name: MHC class II and lipid antigen presentation, TLR7/8 module
rationale: All members are antigen processing/presentation, centred on MHC class II in B cells, and unlike the confusables include the TLR7/8 co-expression module and MHC Ib lipid antigen presentation.

name: Neuronal microtubule transport and tubulin polyglutamylation
rationale: Members are kinesin/axonal-dendritic organelle and vesicle transport plus tubulin C-terminal glutamylation and microtubule severing, the latter absent from all transport confusables.

name: Macrophage cholesterol efflux, HDL assembly and foam cell formation
rationale: Members concern LXR/ABCA1-driven cholesterol efflux, HDL assembly, cholesterol storage and oxLDL responses in macrophage foam cells, whereas confusables emphasise HDL/LDL remodelling and reverse cholesterol transport.

name: Inherited adrenal steroidogenic cytochrome P450 deficiencies
rationale: All five are congenital defects of adrenal steroidogenic P450s (CYP11A1, CYP17A1, CYP21A2, CYP11B1, CYP11B2) causing adrenal hyperplasia/insufficiency, unlike confusables covering normal sex-steroid or mineralocorticoid biosynthesis.

qualifier: lens, anterior segment and hyaloid vasculature
name: Eye morphogenesis of lens, anterior segment and hyaloid vasculature
rationale: Members are eye development processes (optic cup, lens fibre, cornea, iris, eyelid, optic nerve, hyaloid regression), distinct from confusables focused on photoreceptor/retinal neuron differentiation or retinal vasculature.

name: Common gamma-chain and beta-common interleukin receptor signaling
rationale: Members are IL-2, IL-7, IL-9 (gamma-c) and IL-3, IL-5 (beta-c) signaling with SHC and CSF3 inactivation, while confusables cover FLT3/STAT5, IL-15/IL-21 T/NK signaling or IL-6 family.

qualifier: amino acid conjugation of aromatic acids
name: Glutamine/glutamate metabolism and glycine conjugation of aromatic acids
rationale: Members are glutamate, glutamine and aspartate nitrogen metabolism plus mitochondrial glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate, which the proline/glycine, alanine and amide confusables lack.

qualifier: Fas and TRAIL in T cells and hepatocytes
name: Fas/TRAIL death receptor apoptosis regulation in lymphocytes and hepatocytes
rationale: Members are Fas/FasL and TRAIL death-receptor apoptosis and its regulation (BID activation, T-cell AICD, thymocyte and hepatocyte apoptosis), while confusables centre on caspase-8/c-FLIP and T-cell signaling modules.

name: RhoA, RhoB and RhoC GTPase cycles
rationale: The three members are the RHOA/B/C GTPase cycles, distinct from confusables built on CDC42, RAC, RHOG/J/D/U/V or actin protrusion processes.

qualifier: antioxidant detoxification and heme oxygenase control
name: Reactive oxygen/nitrogen species responses and antioxidant detoxification
rationale: Members are cellular responses to H2O2, NO, reactive nitrogen and H2S with ROS detoxification, BACH1/HMOX1, MTF1 and ferroptosis promotion, whereas confusables concern mitochondrial respiration control and oxidative-stress apoptosis.

qualifier: face, palate, limbs and pharyngeal-derived glands
name: Face, palate, limb and pharyngeal-derived organ morphogenesis
rationale: Members are embryonic morphogenesis of face, palate, outer ear, limbs/digits and pharyngeal-pouch organs (thymus, parathyroid, thyroid) plus spleen, unlike confusables on neural plate/head patterning or cardiac outflow.

name: CHD-family and NuRD chromatin remodeling, nucleosome assembly
rationale: Members are nucleosome organization and replication-dependent chromatin assembly with CHD subfamily and NuRD remodelers, arginine methylation and E2F6 repression, while confusables centre on BAF complexes, acetylation or DNA-repair chromatin.

name: Semaphorin-3A axon repulsion and sympathetic innervation
rationale: Members are Sema3A-plexin repulsion (CRMP, PAK, integrin inhibition) with axon guidance and sympathetic projection extension, distinct from Sema4D, netrin and axon-regeneration confusables.

name: TCA cycle and lipoylated 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes
rationale: Members are TCA cycle steps plus the lipoylated PDH, OGDH, OADH and glycine cleavage complexes sharing DLD and protein lipoylation, which confusables on CoA synthesis, B6/serine or Fe-S clusters lack.

name: Lung branching morphogenesis and epithelial bud growth
rationale: All members concern lung growth, lobe formation and epithelial bud elongation/branching, distinct from alveolar pneumocyte differentiation and mesenchymal signaling confusables.

name: Glycogen storage diseases of defective glycogen synthesis
rationale: All four are GSDs from loss of glycogen-synthesizing enzymes (GYS1, GYS2, GYG1, GBE1), unlike confusables on glycogenolysis, G6Pase defects or glucokinase.

name: Erythroid differentiation and terminal red cell maturation
rationale: Members are primitive/definitive erythrocyte differentiation, enucleation, red cell membrane and oxygen transport modules, distinct from HSC homeostasis, megakaryocyte, myeloid progenitor and heme synthesis confusables.

name: White adipogenesis and PPAR signaling regulation
rationale: Members are white fat cell differentiation/proliferation, fat pad development, PPARG-driven adipogenesis and PPAR signaling regulation, unlike brown/beige, LXR lipogenesis and PPARA/circadian confusables.

qualifier: gluconeogenic amino acids, choline and carnitine
name: Gluconeogenic amino acid, choline and carnitine metabolism
rationale: Members combine alanine and threonine catabolism with oxaloacetate/gluconeogenesis and choline catabolism with carnitine synthesis, a loose hepatic metabolic grouping distinct from glutamate/aromatic amino acid, biotin/FMO and fatty-acyl-CoA confusables.

name: Factor XII contact activation and fibrinolysis regulation
rationale: Members are FXII/plasma kallikrein intrinsic coagulation, hereditary angioedema, amyloid-induced FXII activation, plasminogen activation and fibrin clot dissolution, distinct from extrinsic/common coagulation, VWF and MMP confusables.

qualifier: proteasome, PD-L1 regulation and viral evasion
name: Proteasomal MHC class I presentation, PD-L1 and viral evasion
rationale: Members are proteasome-dependent MHC I processing and cross-presentation plus Nef-mediated CD4/CD8/MHC-I downregulation and PD-L1 regulation of anti-tumour T cells, whereas confusables centre on MHC class II and dendritic-cell signatures.

qualifier: p53-driven G1/G2 arrest after ionizing radiation
name: p53-dependent G1/G2 arrest after ionizing radiation
rationale: Members are DNA damage checkpoint signaling, responses to gamma/X-rays, p53 phosphorylation/degradation control and p53-driven G1/G2 arrest genes, which confusables (GTSE1, MASTL, DNA repair genes) lack.

name: Amyloid-beta formation, clearance and astroglial activation regulation
rationale: Members regulate amyloid-beta formation, fibrillization and clearance together with astrocyte/microglia activation, glial proliferation, ectodomain proteolysis and LTP suppression, the glial and shedding terms separating it from tau/APP-synthesis and microglial confusables.

name: Xenobiotic biotransformation by CYP2E1, acetylation and methylation
rationale: Members are xenobiotic, alkaloid and benzene-compound detoxification with CYP2E1, paracetamol ADME and acetylation/methylation conjugation, distinct from CYP1A2/FMO/sulfonation and glycine-conjugation confusables.
